settings.heading: Heroes discount program
settings.tagline: At Apex Coatings and Engraving, we proudly honor the sacrifice and service of those who protect and serve our communities. That dedication deserves recognition.

settings.title: Active military
settings.text: All active duty branches — Army, Navy, Air Force, Marines, Coast Guard, Space Force. Currently serving our country.

settings.title: Veterans
settings.text: Honorably discharged veterans of any branch of the United States Armed Forces. Your service is never forgotten.

settings.title: Firefighters
settings.text: Career and volunteer firefighters. The men and women who run toward danger so others can run away.

settings.title: Law enforcement
settings.text: Police officers, sheriffs, deputies, state troopers, and federal law enforcement keeping our communities safe.

settings.title: Emergency medical
settings.text: EMTs, paramedics, and emergency medical responders. First on scene when every second counts.

settings.title: Healthcare heroes
settings.text: Nurses, doctors, and frontline healthcare workers. Dedicated to healing and saving lives every single day.

settings.title: Service members and first responders
settings.subtitle: If you serve your community, this discount is for you.

settings.title: Browse and order
settings.text: Choose your products or services and submit your order form on our website.

settings.title: Mention your service
settings.text: In the order notes or contact form, let us know your branch, department, or role.

settings.title: Provide verification
settings.text: Bring or email a valid ID, badge, or military/VA card at pickup or with your request.

settings.title: 10% discount applied
settings.text: We apply your 10% heroes discount to the final invoice. No codes needed.

settings.title: Crafted for those who carry
settings.subtitle: Custom engraving and Cerakote finishing, including military and first responder themed designs.

settings.title: Ready to place your order?
settings.text: Mention your service in the order notes and we will apply your 10% heroes discount automatically. Thank you for everything you do.
